notes.title: v 0.9.940
notes.content: Improved Text Clarity on low resolutions screens (720 and 800) Steam Deck’s screen, for example

notes.title: v 0.9.921
notes.content:
Fixed vsync on mac
 Changed some texts in catalan and german
 If enemies got damaged when exiting the room, their transparency value didn't reset
 When moving blocks, if you paused the game, it still rumbled
 Al elf in the village had the dialog small when zoomed out
 Spider room in the Nature Temple didn’t stayed opened when reloading
 Respawning after death in specific situations could move the character to odd places in interiors
 Improved slime respawning
 Final Boss didn’t moved from the first phase

notes.title: v 0.9.902
notes.content:
In a couple caves in the Beach  you couldn't jump from high floor
 In a cave in the beach the darkness was deactivated
 The tourist dialog in Cales was missing 2 sentences
 When you pushed colums to the arrow shooter, when they were very near they didn't collide properly with the columns

notes.title: v 0.9.899
notes.content:
We've upgraded the engine because of the crashes some people with certain hardware were randomly happening during dialogs. **If you still experience them, please let us know!**
 New bushes in forest town were buggy
 Fixed a spot in the city where you jumped through water and could get stuck
 Fixed a similar spot in the water temple
 Treadmills and ice interaction improved so the player doesn't get super speed
 Fixed a block in the Electric Temple that could get moved only once
 Fixed a spot in the beach caves that respawned you in bad spots after drowning
 Blocked a path in the water in the Forest so it doesn't happen the same as the last point
 Potion effects reset when transitioning areas
 Fixed collision of rocks in wind caves so you don't get stuck when dashing
 Fixed bridge in the mountains that had improper collisions when dashing
 You could trigger the cutscene opening the door in the mountains town by talking to a character (instead of interacting with the door)
 There was a change of camera in Cales that turned the camera pink (like the transitions to the Academy)
 A statue in the Earth Temple didn't reset properly
 You could plant vines from a high ground in Essedegat
 Some text changes

notes.title: v 0.9.898
notes.content:
Finished improving collisions on the remaining biomes. (Desert, Mountains, City and Academy)
 Now you can't trigger 2 dialogs at once.
 Fixed sprite layer of scaffolds in the last temple
 Player map position shows the proper position on the academy
 Added a lever that respawns rafts so you can't get locked in a puzzle in the Water Temple

notes.title: v 0.9.897
notes.content:
We are improving collision on narrow spots (stairs, caves, etc). Volcano, Forest and Snow Mountains and Beach have been worked on for the moment.
 A chest in the Nature Temple, with a scroll, was triggering the smoke infinitely under certain conditions

We have changed a bit the path to Tramunt from the Forest Town, making it a bit more obvious
 Changed a bit how the dialogs render (some people are experiencing crashes)
 If you died while being poisoned, you respawn with the poison particles activated
 Markers menu on the map screen could be cut when placed on the right

notes.title: v 0.9.893
notes.content:
Soldiers, ice slimes and Fire Golem respawn properly (they could be invisible)
 A block in the training temple and some wind redirectors in the last temple didn't have the proper sprite layer

notes.title: v 0.9.891
notes.content:
You might have the sword unusable after the cutscene where the elfs push you into the Temple
 Ice slimes could have the wrong material, making them look like squares
 Damage when dashing could get you stuck
 Rovella now block the south way until you help her brother Renat
 A forest cave transition between rooms is now fixed

notes.title: v 0.9.89
notes.content:
Dying while climbing no longer keeps you in the climbing state
 Scroll in Nature Temple no longer locks you in place
 Statues in Wind Temple (first room) no longer trap you
 A puzzle in Wind Temple solved without doing the proper solution

notes.title: v 0.9.88
notes.content:
The west transition of Tramunt's town wasn't properly placed
 A couple doors in Tramunt needed the player to move down before entering
 A couple ledges in Tramunt could be crossed

notes.title: v 0.9.86
notes.content:
The elf blocking the way towards the Nature Temple didn't have his collider properly set up
 Added stairs on the Water Temple to avoid soft lock in two spots
 Moved a mechanism on the Water Temple to avoid soft lock
 Improved water collisions. Before you might get between two water tiles without drowning.

notes.title: v 0.9.85
notes.content:
Jumps from rafts in Water Temple fixed
 Splash sound when jumping on a raft wasn't always playing
 You can't lure the shark outside the blocks now
 A room could activate the water level, drowning you instantly
 You can't skip the mall guard using ice
